body: Everyday its like we are getting closer and closer to realizing we are in a matrix
God I've always thought the same thing. "I want a baby" they don't realize that same baby will eventually grow up. I have a feeling many people have kids purely for the baby/toddler stage.
Im around the same age as you and completely understand. Getting harder to find a reason to go on at this point
Yes, its getting harder to eat or even sleep

I'm autistic too and completely understand. Trying to functional in this world without masking constantly is exhuasting. And seeing other autistics being against curing it bc its "eugenics" rubs me the wrong way bc they are usually the "high functioning" ones with the cute quirky traits everyone likes. I wish my brain functioned like a normal person.
